title: Cherat Cement reports 2026 financial year results
summary: Cherat Cement reports 2026 financial year results
body_markdown: **Pakistan:** Cherat Cement has reported profits of US$25.9m in the 2026 financial year, reflecting a 16% year-on-year decline. Net revenue for the quarter to 30 June 2026 declined by 9% year-on-year to US$32.9m, though it increased by 13% quarter-on-quarter, driven by higher domestic despatches.
